title: QuotaCo bike rack and street light revision

directions.label: LOW STAPLE BANK
directions.cue: Three broad inverted-U locking hoops and six explicit ground mounts.
directions.tradeoff: Strongest conventional rack read with the quietest far silhouette.

directions.label: WHEEL CHANNELS
directions.cue: Four plan-projected wheel slots terminate in one service rail.
directions.tradeoff: Clear parking function up close, but the narrow slots compress at far zoom.

directions.label: DOCKING RAIL
directions.cue: Three lock posts and approach channels make the interaction face explicit.
directions.tradeoff: Most QuotaCo-specific, but risks reading as scooter or charging infrastructure.

directions.label: OFFSET SERVICE ARM
directions.cue: One bent mast carries a broad, shielded lamp with a visible luminous underside.
directions.tradeoff: Most immediate street-light read while retaining a compact 1×1 base.

directions.label: TWIN PARKING HEAD
directions.cue: A centered mast and two opposing heads establish parking-lot coverage.
directions.tradeoff: Strong facility read, though the wide top becomes busier near walls.

directions.label: HOODED CAMPUS LANTERN
directions.cue: A low shielded cap and glowing core favor paths and employee spaces.
directions.tradeoff: Warmest campus character, but less clearly a street light at far zoom.
